title: Disabled "Start 7-day free trial" link is not focusable/announced as disabled and is not tied to the 21+ checkbox [4.1.2 Name, Role, Value]
steps: Inspect the trial control while the checkbox is unchecked
expected: While the checkbox is unchecked the trial control is announced as a disabled button/link (or stays focusable with aria-disabled and a described-by hint: "Confirm you are 21+ first"). Checkbox and button are programmatically related.
actual: Control is <a aria-disabled="true"> with no href, so it has no link role, is not in the tab order, and a screen reader reads it as plain text "Start 7-day free trial" rather than a disabled control. Nothing explains that the checkbox gates it (no aria-describedby). The checkbox label also says "I am legally allowed to bet where I live" while the product copy elsewhere says 21+. Same component on /login.
evidence: Outer HTML: Start 7-day free trial; checkbox has aria-describedby null
